description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Mr. H.S.S. Thuyakontha as Secretary to the Ministry of Defence and Mr. D.W.R.B. Seneviratne as Secretary of Public Security With Effect from September 23, 2024
reasoning: This gazette exclusively lists the appointments of named individuals (Mr. H. S. S. Thuyacontha and Mr. D. W. R. B. Seneviratne) to the positions of Secretary to the Ministry of Defence and Secretary to the Ministry of Public Security. It provides their names and basic titles but does not include any detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
